name: Residl
tagline: Enterprise payroll infrastructure for the modern production entity.
positioning: Residl runs cast, crew, and residual payroll across every union, jurisdiction, and production entity from a single system of record.

hero.h1: Payroll built for the production entity, not the spreadsheet.
hero.sub: Residl processes timecards, gross-to-net, multi-state withholding, union fringes, and residuals across every episode, feature, and commercial your studio delivers.

features.title: Union-Aware Gross-to-Net
features.description: Codified rate cards for IATSE, DGA, SAG-AFTRA, and Teamsters. Meal penalties, turnaround, and overtime tiers calculate per contract without manual overrides.

features.title: Multi-Jurisdiction Withholding
features.description: Automated state, provincial, and localized tax treatment for split-location shoots, with real-time nexus tracking across every loan-out and W-2 worker.

features.title: Residuals Ledger
features.description: Track re-use, secondary market, and streaming residual obligations against title, cast, and guild rules with a fully auditable payment trail.

features.title: Timecard Approval Chains
features.description: Digital start work, DPRs, and daily timecards route through UPM and accountant approval with locked audit history and no email attachments.

features.title: Consolidated Reporting
features.description: Cost reports, hot costs, and GL exports map to your production accounting system and roll up across every entity in the slate.

features.title: Enterprise Access Control
features.description: SSO, SCIM provisioning, and role-scoped permissions keep sensitive compensation data restricted to authorized production staff.

testimonials.quote: We moved eleven concurrent productions onto Residl in a single quarter. Residual liability that used to live in three spreadsheets now reconciles automatically against the guild rules.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Vance

testimonials.quote: Split-location withholding used to require a specialist per state. Residl calculates it correctly on the first check run, and our audit exposure dropped materially.
testimonials.name: Devon Okafor

testimonials.quote: The approval chain alone justified the contract. Every timecard is traceable from set to GL, and our completion bond auditors sign off faster.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For single-entity productions running standard union and non-union payroll.
Volume-based pricing for multi-entity slates with residual obligations.
For studios and payroll service providers at national scale.
